name: Kontron
summary: Kontron AG, established in 1990 and based in Linz, Austria, is a technology company specializing in designing, deploying, and commercializing hardware, software, and comprehensive IT service offerings. The company's operations are structured into three key segments: IT Services, IoT Solutions Europe, and IoT Solutions America. Its IT Services division delivers expert consultation, system integration, and outsourced management for diverse enterprise needs, spanning workplace environments, data centers, cloud infrastructure, and application development and maintenance. This segment also serves as a distributor for hardware and software products from other vendors. Meanwhile, the IoT Solutions segments focus on engineering and implementing specialized hardware and software for the Internet of Things (IoT) and Industry 4.0. These solutions, complete with their operational and deployment services, serve various critical sectors such as industrial automation, medical technology, railway systems, telecommunications, and intelligent energy networks. Beyond these core areas, Kontron's portfolio extends to niche high-tech products like in-flight entertainment systems, digital display solutions for public transportation, robust carrier-grade servers tailored for telecommunications providers, and advanced technologies supporting autonomous driving. Kontron maintains a broad international footprint, with operations spanning Germany, Austria, North America, Hungary, Poland, Russia, Romania, the Czech Republic, Slovenia, China, Croatia, France, Switzerland, Great Britain, Bulgaria, and many other global regions. The company previously operated as S&T AG before officially adopting the name Kontron AG in June 2022.
